verses.text: Dear friends, since we have these promises, let us make ourselves clean from everything that makes body or spirit dirty. Let us become completely holy, because we fear God.
Make room for us in your hearts. We have not wronged anyone. We have not led anyone astray. We have not cheated anyone.
I do not say this to blame you. I have told you before that you are so dear to our hearts that we would die with you or live with you.
I speak to you very openly, and I am very proud of you. I am full of comfort. In all our troubles, my joy is overflowing.
When we came to Macedonia, our bodies had no rest. We met trouble on every side. There were fights all around us, and fears inside us.
But God, who comforts those who are low, comforted us when Titus arrived.

It was not only his coming that comforted us, but also the comfort you had given him. He told us how much you long to see me, how sorry you are, and how much you care for me. So my joy was even greater.
Even if my letter made you sad, I am not sorry I sent it. At first I was sorry, because I see that the letter made you sad, but only for a short time.
Now I am happy. I am not happy that you were made sad, but that your sadness made you turn back to God. You were sad in the way God wants, so we did not harm you in any way.
Sadness of the kind God wants makes people turn away from sin. This leads to being saved, and there is nothing to be sorry about. But the world's kind of sadness brings death.

See what this sadness of God's kind has done in you! It has made you so eager to put things right. It has made you want to clear yourselves. It has made you angry at the wrong, afraid, longing to see me, caring deeply, and ready to see justice done. In every way you have shown that you are innocent in this matter.
So when I wrote to you, it was not because of the one who did wrong, or the one who was wronged. I wrote so that you could see for yourselves, in front of God, how much you care about us.
That is why we have been comforted. And besides our own comfort, we were even happier to see how happy Titus was. All of you gave his spirit new strength.
I had told him how proud I was of you, and you did not let me down. Everything we said to you was true. In the same way, what we told Titus about being proud of you has also turned out to be true.
His love for you grows even more when he remembers how all of you obeyed. You welcomed him with fear and trembling.
I am glad that I can be completely sure of you.
